resources.string: A music capsule with your lockscreen player and a rope-swinging astronaut.
Show album art and slim animated bars while music plays. Tap to open the lockscreen media player.
Welcome on play, goodbye on pause, and playful left/right swings. The rope retracts and fades below the bar. Requires Motion bar.

Both switches apply immediately. The bar stays while music plays, even with the character off. Turning the bar off hides both; your character preference is kept. A pause gesture finishes its goodbye before the bar hides. Screen off and ambient display hide both. Battery saver and reduced motion use a still pose and static bars.
